Who am I

As a Medical Virtual Assistant, I help healthcare practices run smoothly through organized, accurate, and HIPAA-compliant support. With 6+ years of experience in healthcare customer service and quality control, I provide tailored solutions that align with each practice's workflow and needs.

Accuracy comes from a careful process, built on years of experience in healthcare support and a commitment to protecting patient information.

What I bring to the table

Healthcare Insurance Customer Service

Assist patients with insurance inquiries, eligibility verification, benefits clarification, and coverage-related concerns while ensuring accurate and courteous support.

Medical Billing & Revenue Cycle Support

Support billing operations, claims processing, payment inquiries, claim follow-ups, and resolution of billing discrepancies to help maintain an efficient revenue cycle.

Patient Coordination & Referral Management

Coordinate patient referrals, manage appointment-related requests, monitor referral statuses, and facilitate communication between patients and healthcare providers.

Administrative & Data Management

Handle daily administrative tasks, maintain organized records, update databases, manage documentation, and ensure accurate data entry.

Quality Assurance & Process Improvement

Review transactions and workflows for accuracy, identify inconsistencies, monitor service quality, and recommend improvements to operational processes.

Customer Relations & Resolution

Deliver professional customer support, address concerns, resolve service-related issues, and maintain positive relationships through clear and empathetic communication.

Healthcare Documentation

Prepare, organize, and maintain healthcare records, referral letters, billing documents, and other essential medical correspondence while observing confidentiality standards.
